Feel Great core — three drinks, one window

Unimate
Ultra-concentrated purified yerba mate drink. Supports energy, focus, mood, and appetite. Regular and Decaf (under 15 mg caffeine). Flavours include Natural Lemon, Lemon Ginger, and Raspberry Pomegranate.
Balance
Pre-meal fiber drink. Helps you feel full and supports blood sugar that is already in a healthy range, and healthy cholesterol handling. Original flavours: Orange, Mixed Berry. 4 g fiber per packet as presented.
Balance Apple
The upgraded Balance: seven-fiber matrix, apple polyphenols, apple cider vinegar, about 5 g fiber per serving. Natural Apple flavour only.
Feel Great System pack
One 30-count Balance box + two 30-count Unimate boxes, for a month of the routine on the Feel Great page.

Muscle, bone, and joint

StrongHold
Muscle nutrition for building and preserving lean muscle, especially while fasting or ageing. Muscle-building ingredients (HMB, creatine, and leucine) in whey protein isolate. Peach Mango flavour.
Bone Complex
Vitamin and mineral drink for bone health and calcium absorption, with vitamin C and D, magnesium, and zinc. Mixes with Unimate.
Joint Mobility
Capsule blend for joint function, mobility, and cartilage strength, with undenatured collagen type II, vitamin D3, turmeric, and boswellia.
OmegaLife-3 Resolv
Purified fish-oil supplement, 1,500 mg of healthy fish-oil fats (EPA and DHA) per serving, presented for heart health, brain health, and healthy inflammation support.

Hydration, energy, and everyday wellness

Signal
Hydration and electrolyte drink with magnesium, potassium, sodium, calcium, plus L-citrulline and beetroot extract. Sugar-free, caffeine-free, presented as fasting-friendly.
Chi-Oka Matcha
Matcha green-tea energy drink for clean energy and calm focus, with guarana, L-theanine, L-carnitine, and B vitamins. No sugar crash or jitters, as presented.
Everyday Protein
Minimal protein powder: just whey protein isolate, real cocoa, salt, and stevia. 20 g protein per serving. Use in your eating window.
Oasis
Beauty-from-within drink for skin hydration, with marine collagen, hyaluronic acid, vitamin C, and antioxidants.
Super Green+
Plant-phytonutrient drink for antioxidant, immune, and digestive support, with chlorophyllin and spirulina.
Immunizen
Immune-support capsule built on bovine colostrum, yeast beta-glucans, arabinogalactan, and lactoferrin.

Digestion and Cleanse

Cleanse kit (30 days)
Three products in stages: Paraway Plus, LiFiber, and Aloe Vera — first clear, then nourish the microbiome.
ProBionic Plus
Daily probiotic, 11 strains, 5 billion CFU per serving, microencapsulated for delivery to the lower gut.
LiFiber
Psyllium-husk fiber drink with an herbal blend, for regularity and microbiome support.
Paraway Plus / Aloe Vera
Herbal gut support and a gentle, short-term digestive capsule. Both are explicitly not for long-term use in their profiles — follow the pack label.

Inside Unimate — from yerba mate, not coffee

Unimate is made from yerba mate, concentrated through Unicity's five-step BioSelect process. That is why it is presented as energy and focus, not just caffeine — with chlorogenic acids and mate saponins from the leaf itself.

Bundles, as Unicity presents them

3X System: Balance + Unimate + StrongHold, for metabolic health plus muscle.

U Workout bundle: Unimate + Signal + StrongHold, bound together in Unicity's profiles — not a separate product on its own.

All descriptions above are paraphrased from Unicity's own product profiles, as presented by Unicity, not independently verified here. Follow the pack label for use, and talk to your provider about medication, pregnancy, nursing, or any medical condition.

Expensive? Do the math.

People hear the monthly price and flinch — until they break it down by day.

About $5.30 a day

That is 3 drinks a day, for a full month, on the direct subscription price in Unicity's materials: $159 for a 30-day pack, divided by 30 days. That is about $1.77 per drink.

Compare that to one Starbucks Grande latte, which 2026 price guides put at about $5.25 before tax, and most people spend $5 to $7 per visit.

One latte = about $5.25. Three Feel Great drinks = about $5.30 a day. Same daily spend, completely different job.

Prices change, so check the current price at Unicity checkout before you buy. The $159 subscription figure is from Unicity's materials, not a price this site guarantees. Starbucks figures are from 2026 price guides, and vary by store and size.
